mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUM NUMBER(12) NOT NULL, MO_ACCEPTTIME VARCHAR2(14), MO_MODIFIED VARCHAR2(14), MO_NUMBER VARCHAR2(20), MO_SENDER VARCHAR2(20), MO_ORGADDR VARCHAR2(20), MO_MSG VARCHAR2(160), MO_SN NUMBER(12), MO_NET VARCHAR2(10), MO_STATUS VARCHAR2(1), MO_REPLY_DATE VARCHAR2(14), MO_REPLY_MSG VARCHAR2(160), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY ( MO_NUM ) )

CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUMBER VARCHAR2(20), ALARM_YN VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT'N', ALARM_DAY_TIME VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT'09:00~18:00', ALARM_DAY_RECEIVERS VARCHAR2(200), ALARM_DAY_SENDER VARCHAR2(20), ALARM_NIGHT_TIME VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT'18:00~09:00', ALARM_NIGHT_RECEIVERS VARCHAR2(200), ALARM_NIGHT_SENDER VARCHAR2(20), ALARM_MSG VARCHAR2(160), AUTO_REPLY_YN VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT'N', AUTO_REPLY_MSG VARCHAR2(160) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( MO_NUM, MO_ACCEPTTIME, MO_MODIFIED, MO_NUMBER, MO_SENDER, MO_ORGADDR, MO_MSG, MO_SN, MO_STATUS, MO_NET ) VALUES ( ${tableName}_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{parameter.receiveDate}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{parameter.moNumber}, #{parameter.callback}, #{parameter.sender}, #{parameter.message}, #{parameter.moKey}, #{parameter.status}, #{parameter.telco} )
